candidates: src/sentry/api/paginator.py:838 - OptimizedCursorPaginator can't handle the datetime key used by audit logs.. The audit log endpoint uses this paginator with `order_by="-datetime"`, so `getattr(item, self.key)` returns a `datetime`. `math.floor`/`math.ceil` on a datetime raises `TypeError` in `build_cursor`, so every request with `optimized_pagination=true` that returns rows fails with a 500. `value_from_cursor` also passes the raw integer cursor value to `build_queryset`, where it is compared with a DateTimeField. `DateTimePaginator` converts both ways (epoch ↔ datetime). Fix: subclass `DateTimePaginator` or reuse its `get_item_key`/`value_from_cursor`.

src/sentry/api/paginator.py:877 - Negative cursor offsets are passed straight into a queryset slice.. A client can send a cursor like `0:-10:0`, and `queryset[-10:...]` then runs on a Django QuerySet. Django rejects negative indexing ("Negative indexing is not supported"), so this branch can only raise a 500. The comments say it gives "access to data beyond normal pagination bounds" and claim it is "safe because permissions are checked at the queryset level". Any client-controlled feature meant to bypass pagination bounds should be removed, not shipped behind a query flag. Fix: drop the branch and clamp the offset to `max(0, offset)` as before.

src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:46 - Switching from Redis sets to sorted sets breaks segment keys that already exist at deploy time.. Keys written by the old code are SETs. After deploy, `zadd` in `process_spans` and `zcard`/`zunionstore` in this script fail with WRONGTYPE on those keys, and so does `zscan` in flush. The consumer and flusher then error on every batch that touches an in-flight segment until those keys expire. Fix: use a new key prefix for the sorted-set format, or handle and clean up legacy SET keys.

src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:71 - The "admin-only" gate trusts `has_global_access` and can dereference a missing member.. `organization_context.member.has_global_access` is true for any member of an org with open membership, not only administrators, so ordinary members can turn on the negative-offset path. When the user is not a superuser and `member` is None (for example, staff access without membership), this line raises `AttributeError`. It also checks `is_superuser` instead of an active superuser session. Fix: remove this path or gate it on `is_active_superuser(request)` or an explicit scope, and guard against `member is None`.

src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:47 - ZUNIONSTORE sums the scores of duplicate members.. `zunionstore` uses `AGGREGATE SUM` by default. When the same payload is in both sets (for example, a redelivered Kafka message), its score becomes twice its end timestamp. That corrupts the ordering the eviction depends on. Add `"AGGREGATE", "MAX"` to both calls.
